summary: A software prototype for health monitoring during astronaut space missions. It is essential to track the health status of astronauts as they travel into space, and measures must be taken to prevent risks that could affect their physical and mental well-being. Having real-time information on their health status helps them follow recommendations to stay healthy throughout their space mission.
details:
Desktop software for real-time monitoring of the health status of astronauts on space missions.

The prototype was developed using the Python programming language, with the PyQt6 framework for the graphical user interface. Visual Studio Code was used for writing, editing, and executing the project.

Artificial intelligence tools used for this challenge:

- ChatGPT: Gathering information and analyzing the Human Research Program website.

- Antigravity: Generating code for the development of the prototype.

This project is designed to allow astronauts to check their health status in real time, thereby reducing the risks associated with long-duration space missions. It also incorporates artificial intelligence that tracks data regarding an astronaut's condition and provides recommendations to help stabilize their health.
